products.name: Cute Little Cup – Footed Smiley Mug & Saucer Set
products.description: An adorable cream cup sitting happily on its matching saucer, with a hand-painted smiling face, glossy chocolate feet and “CUTE LITTLE CUP” written around the plate rim. Sized for a small cappuccino or cocoa — the photo shows it filled with marshmallow hot chocolate. Each face is painted by hand, so every little cup has its own personality.

Fully customizable — add your own words under the glaze for a one-of-a-kind holiday gift. The photos show it styled with a marshmallow hot chocolate for cozy winter evenings.

products.name: “Today is Your Day” Mug
products.availability: Made to order · ships in 5–7 days
products.description: A soft cream mug with a secret hidden inside: “Today is Your Day” is hand-stamped with tiny red hearts at the bottom of the cup, revealed as you finish your drink. A joyful little morning ritual — or a meaningful motivational gift for someone who needs the reminder.
